Find the null rows of a struct column

Source: R/parquet-nested.R
is_null_struct.Rd

qio reads a Parquet struct as a data-frame column. A null struct and a struct whose fields are all null both have NA in every field, so an optional struct carries which rows are null itself. is_null_struct() returns that.

Usage

is_null_struct(x)

Arguments

x

A data-frame column that collect() or read_parquet() returned for a Parquet struct, or any data frame.

Value

A logical vector with one value per row of x: TRUE where the struct is null. A required struct, or any data frame qio did not make, is never null, so the result is all FALSE.

Row subsetting (x[i, ], and subsetting the data frame holding x) keeps the mask in step. Combining rows with rbind() does not, and is_null_struct() then refuses rather than guess.

See also

The "Nested columns" section of collect().

Examples

path <- tempfile(fileext = ".parquet")
write_parquet(data.frame(x = 1:3), path)
is_null_struct(read_parquet(path))
#> [1] FALSE FALSE FALSE
